messages.dashboard.kds.body: Piliin kung aling van ang bubuksan ang kitchen display (KDS):
messages.emailCustomer.offlineRejectReason: Nawalan ng internet connection ang van, kaya hindi nakumpirma ang order na ito.
messages.auth.verifyEmail.successBody: Napalitan na ng {email} ang email mo. Nila-log out ka namin…
messages.comparison.features.staff.explain: Nagla-log in ang staff gamit ang sarili nilang login at role.
messages.auth.signup.consent: Sa paggawa ng account, sumasang-ayon ka sa aming <terms>Mga Tuntunin</terms> at <privacy>Patakaran sa Privacy</privacy>. Hindi kailangan ng card. Walang magiging public hangga’t hindi mo sinasabi.
messages.demoGetStarted.agreeTerms: Sumasang-ayon ako sa <terms>Mga Tuntunin</terms> at <privacy>Patakaran sa Privacy</privacy>.
messages.demoUpload.emailNote: Ie-email namin sa iyo ang link sa demo mo at baka makipag-ugnayan kami tungkol sa pag-set up ng HatchGrab. <link>Patakaran sa Privacy</link>
messages.demoGetStarted.upload.privacy: Gagamitin lang namin ito para i-set up ang truck mo at ipadala ang demo link mo — tingnan ang aming <link>Patakaran sa Privacy</link>.
messages.demoGetStarted.sample.privacy: Gagamitin lang namin ito para i-set up ang truck mo at ipadala ang demo link mo — tingnan ang aming <link>Patakaran sa Privacy</link>.
messages.demoGetStarted.saveOnly.privacy: Gagamitin lang namin ito para ipadala ang demo link mo — tingnan ang aming <link>Patakaran sa Privacy</link>.
messages.deleteAccount.whatAccounting: Ang anonymous na accounting records ay itatabi nang anim na taon, ayon sa hinihingi ng batas ng UK. Tingnan ang aming Patakaran sa Privacy.
messages.demoGetStarted.fieldError.terms: Pakitanggap ang Mga Tuntunin para magpatuloy.
messages.errorsManage.wp_last_toggle: Panatilihing naka-on ang Location o Time (sa post para sa isang event: Venue o Time). Ang na-cancel na event ay nagpapakita ng lugar nito na may guhit at ng salitang NA-CANCEL, kaya kapag parehong naka-off, walang magsasabing na-cancel ito.
messages.setup.identity.phoneHelp: Makikita ito ng mga customer sa order confirmation nila para makapagtanong sila tungkol sa order. Ang tick ang magdedesisyon kung “Tawagan kami” o “Mag-message sa amin sa WhatsApp” ang lalabas. Puwede mong palitan ang dalawa sa Settings.
messages.manageMenuImport.allergensNotSet.bodySet: I-review ang mga ito bago mag-go live. Naka-flag ang mga item bilang “hindi pa naka-set ang allergens” hangga’t hindi mo ito ginagawa.
messages.manageMenuImport.allergensNotSet.body: I-review ang mga ito sa Settings bago mag-go live. Naka-flag ang mga item bilang “hindi pa naka-set ang allergens” hangga’t hindi mo ito ginagawa.
messages.landing.does.whatsappBody: “Saan kayo mamayang gabi?” “Anong dessert ang meron kayo?” Nasasagot ang WhatsApp mo habang nagmamaneho ka papunta sa pwesto o nasa grill ka, gamit ang sarili mong menu at schedule. Malapit na ang Messenger at Instagram.
messages.landing.does.whatsappSoonBody: “Saan kayo mamayang gabi?” “Anong dessert ang meron kayo?” Malapit nang masagot ang WhatsApp mo habang nagmamaneho ka papunta sa pwesto o nasa grill ka. Susunod ang Messenger at Instagram.
messages.plansPdf.priceNoteMasked: Hindi pa naka-publish ang mga presyong may “Kukumpirmahin pa”.
messages.settingsCopy.orderReady.help: Magpakita ng button na “Markahang ready” sa orders screen. Hiwalay na naka-set ang mga kitchen display (KDS), sa bawat device. Ini-email ang customer tuwing minamarkahang ready ang isang order. Para sa lahat ng event — puwede mo pa rin itong i-on o i-off para sa isang event sa dashboard nito.
messages.paymentActions.paidCardMachine: Nagbayad sa card reader mo{mixed, select, yes { — {amount}} other {}}
messages.paymentActions.inPersonHint: Cash o card reader mo — hindi naka-record
messages.addOrder.savedToast: Na-save ang order {id}{paid, select, cash { — bayad sa cash} card { — bayad sa card reader mo} other {}}
messages.addOrder.confirmedToast: Kumpirmado ang order #{id}{paid, select, cash { — bayad sa cash} card { — bayad sa card reader mo} other {}}
messages.compare.breakdown.card: Card processing — {fee} ng Stripe kada order, bayad sa Stripe. Halos ganito rin ang babayaran mo sa card reader sa truck.
messages.comparison.faq.whatA: Tumatanggap ang ordering system ng order online bago pa makarating ang customers sa truck: pipili sila ng pagkain at oras ng pick-up, magbabayad online o sa pick-up, at lalabas ang order sa kusina mo. Ang POS o card reader naman ang tumatanggap ng bayad sa truck. Nagtutulungan ang dalawa.
messages.eventTypes.phone.noMenuItems: Wala pang menu items — idagdag ang mga ito sa Menu › Mga item.
messages.manageMenu.item.preorderHelp: Isama ang item na ito sa pre-orders. Ang timing at rule ay naka-set para sa lahat sa Settings → Mga pre-order.
messages.addOrder.addAnotherDeal: + Magdagdag ng isa pang combo meal
messages.addOrder.chooseRequired: Piliin ang mga required na option
messages.dashboard.settings.dueSoundTitle: Tunog kapag oras nang lutuin ang order
messages.kds.panel.soundDue: Tunog kapag oras nang lutuin ang order
messages.kds.panel.soundNeedsConfirming: Mga order lang na kailangang kumpirmahin
messages.kds.event.endNow: Tapusin ang event na ito? Hindi na tatanggap ng order.
messages.kds.event.endEarly: Hindi pa dapat matatapos ang event na ito hanggang {time}. Hindi na tatanggap ng order. Kumpirmahin ang pagtatapos ng event?
messages.dashboard.screenOff.title: Payagang mag-off ang screen?
messages.dashboard.screenOff.body: Naka-on ngayon ang offline order protection. Kapag nag-off ang screen at nawalan ng connection ang device, puwedeng kusang ma-pause ang online ordering.
messages.dashboard.screenOff.confirm: Sigurado ka bang papayagan mong mag-off ang screen?
messages.errorsKitchen.busy_retry: Marami kaming order ngayon — pakisubukan ulit
messages.errorsCustomer.category_closed: Sarado ang {category} para sa event na ito
messages.errorsManage.collection_intervals_save_f: Hindi ma-save ang mga oras ng pick-up ngayon.
messages.errorsManage.collection_interval_choices: Kailangang tuwing {choices} minuto ang mga oras ng pick-up.
messages.demoUpload.emailInvalid: Maglagay ng valid na email address.
messages.weeklyPostApi.placeStatus.none: Wala pang larawan — Standard ang gamit
messages.postShare.copyFailed: Hindi makopya — piliin ang text at kopyahin ito nang mano-mano.
messages.kds.pin.unreachable: Hindi maabot ang server ngayon. Walang problema sa PIN mo — subukan ulit maya-maya.
messages.errorsManage.wp_private_no_single_post: Walang sariling post ang mga private event — lumalabas ang mga ito sa weekly poster mo bilang “Private event”.
messages.errorsManage.live_event_needs_times: Kailangan ng start at end time ang live event — idagdag muna ang mga ito bago i-save.
messages.order.authFailed: Hindi na-authorize ang payment na iyan. Walang perang nakuha — sumubok ng ibang card, o piliin ang Magbayad sa truck.
messages.emailCustomer.payNote.unknownBody: Na-authorize ang card mo, kaya huwag ka nang magbayad ulit — kukumpirmahin ito ng {truck} sa truck.
messages.emailCustomer.payNote.unknownText: Kinukumpirma pa namin ang bayad mo. Na-authorize ang card mo, kaya huwag ka nang magbayad ulit — kukumpirmahin ito ng {truck} sa truck.
messages.errorsKitchen.already_paid_by_card: Nagbayad na gamit ang card ang customer na ito. Naka-authorize na ang card niya para sa order na ito at awtomatiko itong sisingilin kapag kinumpirma mo, kaya kapag tumanggap ka pa ng bayad dito, dalawang beses siyang masisingil. Walang na-record.
messages.orderCard.cardHeldTitle: Naka-authorize ang card — huwag singilin. Kukunin ang bayad kapag kinumpirma mo.

back.dashboard.kds.body: Choose which van’s kitchen display (KDS) to open:
back.emailCustomer.offlineRejectReason: The van lost its internet connection, so this order could not be confirmed.
back.auth.verifyEmail.successBody: Your email has been changed to {email}. We are logging you out…
back.comparison.features.staff.explain: Staff log in with their own login and role.
back.auth.signup.consent: By creating an account, you agree to our <terms>Terms</terms> and <privacy>Privacy Policy</privacy>. No card needed. Nothing becomes public until you say so.
back.demoGetStarted.agreeTerms: I agree to the <terms>Terms</terms> and <privacy>Privacy Policy</privacy>.
back.demoUpload.emailNote: We will email you the link to your demo and may contact you about setting up HatchGrab. <link>Privacy Policy</link>
back.demoGetStarted.upload.privacy: We will only use this to set up your truck and send your demo link — see our <link>Privacy Policy</link>.
back.demoGetStarted.sample.privacy: We will only use this to set up your truck and send your demo link — see our <link>Privacy Policy</link>.
back.demoGetStarted.saveOnly.privacy: We will only use this to send your demo link — see our <link>Privacy Policy</link>.
back.deleteAccount.whatAccounting: Anonymous accounting records will be kept for six years, as UK law requires. See our Privacy Policy.
back.demoGetStarted.fieldError.terms: Please accept the Terms to continue.
back.errorsManage.wp_last_toggle: Keep Location or Time switched on (on a single event post: Venue or Time). A cancelled event shows its place with a line through it and the word NA-CANCEL (CANCELLED), so when both are off nothing would say it is cancelled.
back.setup.identity.phoneHelp: Customers see this on their order confirmation so they can ask about an order. The tick decides whether “Call us” or “Message us on WhatsApp” appears. You can change both in Settings.
back.manageMenuImport.allergensNotSet.bodySet: Review them before going live. Items are flagged as “allergens not set yet” until you do it.
back.manageMenuImport.allergensNotSet.body: Review them in Settings before going live. Items are flagged as “allergens not set yet” until you do it.
back.landing.does.whatsappBody: “Where are you tonight?” “What desserts do you have?” Your WhatsApp gets answered while you drive to the pitch or are at the grill, using your own menu and schedule. Messenger and Instagram coming soon.
back.landing.does.whatsappSoonBody: “Where are you tonight?” “What desserts do you have?” Soon your WhatsApp will be answered while you drive to the pitch or are at the grill. Messenger and Instagram will follow.
back.plansPdf.priceNoteMasked: Prices marked “To be confirmed” are not published yet.
back.settingsCopy.orderReady.help: Show a “Mark ready” button on the orders screen. Kitchen displays (KDS) are set separately, on each device. The customer is emailed whenever an order is marked ready. Applies to all events — you can still turn it on or off for one event on its dashboard.
back.paymentActions.paidCardMachine: Paid on your card reader{mixed, select, yes { — {amount}} other {}}
back.paymentActions.inPersonHint: Cash or your card reader — not recorded
back.addOrder.savedToast: Order {id} saved{paid, select, cash { — paid in cash} card { — paid on your card reader} other {}}
back.addOrder.confirmedToast: Order #{id} confirmed{paid, select, cash { — paid in cash} card { — paid on your card reader} other {}}
back.compare.breakdown.card: Card processing — Stripe’s {fee} per order, paid to Stripe. You would pay about the same on a card reader at the truck.
back.comparison.faq.whatA: An ordering system takes orders online before customers even reach the truck: they choose food and a pick-up time, pay online or at pick-up, and the order appears in your kitchen. A POS or card reader takes payment at the truck. The two work together.
back.eventTypes.phone.noMenuItems: No menu items yet — add them in Menu › Items.
back.manageMenu.item.preorderHelp: Include this item in pre-orders. The timing and rule are set for everything in Settings → Pre-orders.
back.dashboard.settings.dueSoundTitle: Sound when it is time to cook the order
back.kds.panel.soundDue: Sound when it is time to cook the order
back.kds.event.endNow: Finish this event? No more orders will be taken.
back.kds.event.endEarly: This event should not finish until {time}. No more orders will be taken. Confirm finishing the event?
back.dashboard.screenOff.title: Allow the screen to turn off?
back.dashboard.screenOff.body: Offline order protection is on right now. If the screen turns off and the device loses its connection, online ordering may pause automatically.
back.dashboard.screenOff.confirm: Are you sure you will allow the screen to turn off?
back.errorsKitchen.busy_retry: We have a lot of orders right now — please try again
back.errorsManage.collection_intervals_save_f: The pick-up times can’t be saved right now.
back.errorsManage.collection_interval_choices: Pick-up times must be every {choices} minutes.
back.postShare.copyFailed: Cannot copy — select the text and copy it by hand.
back.kds.pin.unreachable: Can’t reach the server right now. Nothing is wrong with your PIN — try again in a moment.
back.errorsManage.wp_private_no_single_post: Private events have no post of their own — they appear on your weekly poster as “Private event”.
back.errorsManage.live_event_needs_times: A live event needs a start and end time — add them first before saving.
back.order.authFailed: That payment was not authorised. No money was taken — try another card, or choose Pay at the truck.
back.emailCustomer.payNote.unknownBody: Your card was authorised, so do not pay again — {truck} will confirm it at the truck.
back.emailCustomer.payNote.unknownText: We are still confirming your payment. Your card was authorised, so do not pay again — {truck} will confirm it at the truck.
back.errorsKitchen.already_paid_by_card: This customer has already paid by card. Their card is already authorised for this order and will be charged automatically when you confirm it, so if you take payment here too, they will be charged twice. Nothing was recorded.
back.orderCard.cardHeldTitle: Card authorised — don’t charge. Payment is taken when you confirm.
